binding: Root-bound receiver evidence identifies exact target+descriptor bytes, final source/reader/freeze code hashes, Python/package environment, chosen read/hash sequence, allocation/CPU/storage family and cold/warm scope. Producer peak is not a receiver bound.
peak_components: Raw target bytes B and possible decoded JSON text S during strict parse.
Decoded graph D with expanded repeated strings/dicts/lists after JSON sharing loss.
Frozen graph F plus memo/walk bookkeeping M while decoded containers may still be live.
Already retained pilot inventory and its fresh authority proof P.
Actual model staging/host objects H and numeric proof/evidence retention N later in the phase.
Original full-target/M2 tiers and any shared physical storage pools remain separate unchanged admission constraints.
conservative_accounting: Measure peak overlap across read+hash+decode, freeze, post-load model/proofs and final barriers. Do not subtract presumed D/F/string/alias sharing; use actual cgroup peak/events and carefully labeled retained-graph accounting. Ordinary local release is not proof RSS was returned. No GC/allocator/runtime hook.
graph_invariants: Handle stores one frozen graph and exact root/list/requirement identities.
reconciliation.inventory must be the very same graph, and every requirement ID must come from that graph; equal-value copies reject.
_freeze_json already frozen value is idempotent; no second decode, reinterning/coalescing or graph replacement.
Distinct timing records and dummy/source scopes remain distinct/unchanged; immutable scalar sharing may follow normal parser/freeze behavior but is never assumed for the resource bound.
Handle/value/ref/namespace witness cannot be mutated or reinitialized, cross PID/fork or pickle; no execution proof is carried.
resource_rejections: Wrong source/artifact/environment/reader code or changed read-count recipe invalidates receiver evidence.
Understated raw/decode/freeze/retention bound or actual allocation unable to back declared host capacity rejects before model loading.
Measured data+pilot proof+model/numeric retention must fit the actual allocation while preserving original storage guards; no subtracting the old producer peak or waiving tiers.
